criterion: The NAT-020 loader, started from the RECOVERY slot with visible stage markers, reaches its memory preparation, ADT/boot_args and pre-jump stages on the S24 (CRC-valid STAGE frames MAIN, FB, MEM, ZERO, COPY, ADT, CLEAN, PRE_JUMP decoded from an independent recording).
summary: One native run of NAT-022 loader-diag-trig-hold (RECOVERY image sha256 511b4833f0b6c24f5adffe762451bcbf937aa9a23b64bdd41d254885e006c475, Image.payload 7c6206bd06923a91524afe95ec03573ed6fa680978cc839c40991debf7702cb3, source commit 82f636e). It was written to RECOVERY (/dev/block/sda18) with a matching full readback and booted once (adb reboot recovery at 2026-11-10T14:52:43Z). The owner filmed the screen. decode_video.py decoded 567 CRC-valid frames in 0.0-82.6 s of the 84.0 s recording (238 frames failed sync/CRC, 16 grid-poor, 12 no-contrast, 4 no-grid, 1 too-few-edges). The loader stage markers MAIN (0x20) and FB (0x21) were shown, then STAGE 0x3f (FAIL). The hold loop then repeats: STAGE idx1 reached-stage mask 0x0207 (ENTRY, MAIN, FB, FAIL; MEM and later never reached), STAGE idx2 0x2543 = fnv16 of "bad payload header", BOOTID 0x00000a10/0x0fae pair, STAGE 0x3f, REG 0..9 (status 1 and 2 alternating between cycles, GLOBAL_CON 0x133 or 0x113, TRIG_CON 0x3062<->0x3063, FRAME_COUNT advancing, kick count rising 0x18, 0x27, 0x36). No later stage (MEM, ZERO, COPY, ADT, CLEAN, PRE_JUMP) and no XNU entry marker was shown. The loader therefore stopped at its payload header check. check_payload.py, which compiles the loader.c struct and the real condition text and runs it on the flashed payload, finds exactly one firing clause: (p->adt_size & 7), adt_size = 13956 = 0x3684. The screen stayed lit until about 82.7 s of the recording. Stock RECOVERY was restored with one NAT-013 session in Download Mode (enumeration 04e8:685d seen by the host observer at 14:54:39Z, restore 14:55:22Z-14:55:25Z, ADB back 14:56:22Z); the full hash equals stock 96620b8b..., check_android pass, Android booted.

established: The NAT-020 loader code, built from the pinned source, ran on the S24 from the RECOVERY slot under this S-Boot: its own stage markers MAIN and FB and FAIL were drawn and decoded from an independent recording (the loader reached loader_main and the framebuffer selection).
The loader stopped at fail("bad payload header") (fnv16 0x2543, reached-stage mask 0x0207); no later stage was reached.

Host check on the exact flashed payload.bin with the loader.c clause text: exactly one clause fires, (p->adt_size & 7) with adt_size 13956. The payload/loader mismatch is deterministic and independent of the device.
The start.S SCTLR_EL1 M/C halt did not stop this run: the loader code after el1_entry ran (the loader stage markers were drawn).
not_established: Any stage after the payload header check: window choice, RAM zeroing, copy, ADT/boot_args patching, cache clean, the pre-jump marker.
Any XNU entry or marker inside XNU.
Whether the adt_size clause is the only reason beyond the host reproduction (a re-run with a padded adt_size would confirm).

The cause of the dark screen at about 82.7 s (hypothesis: the loader 83 s watchdog, or the S-Boot timer; not measured) and who put the phone into Download Mode (the USB observer started 84 s after the reboot).
The loader ENTRY frame (not seen in the recording; one CRC-valid ENTRY candidate at 8.4 s decodes to 0xfb0b and is treated as a false positive).
Stride and pixel format; whether the kick or S-Boot refresh makes the markers visible (no no-kick control).
